'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeffrey Johns LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
